kyoto_gion_coffee_nanafuku.gf_detail: Ask. Coffee and soft serve alongside hot sandwiches, a cat-shaped French toast and sweets; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_gion_coffee_nanafuku.vegan_detail: Ask. Black coffee, cold brew and lemonade squash are plant-based, but lattes, soft serve and the food use dairy or egg; no plant-milk information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_gion_coffee_nanafuku.hours_raw: Daily 7:30–18:30; hours may change (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). Takeaway (Tabelog). 15 seats over two floors — remove shoes for the tatami-style upper floor; blankets and a clean restroom (Tabelog; April–May 2026). Small dogs allowed on the ground floor, held on your lap (Tabelog). Cards and e-money (Suica, iD, QUICPay); no QR (Tabelog). English menu and English-speaking staff (April 2026). Glass-fronted shop just before Yasaka Shrine near the Gion intersection; about 8 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn (April 2026). Opened 8 February 2022 (Tabelog).
kyoto_gion_coffee_nanafuku.notes: [Coffee · Gion at Yasaka Shrine, open from 7:30] A small two-floor coffee shop just before Yasaka Shrine, open from 7:30 every day: light-roast single origins, a smooth cold brew, café latte and an espresso soft serve that one reviewer called a must, with hot sandwiches and a cat-shaped French toast. Take your shoes off for the upstairs seats by the window over the Gion crossing. Cheerful, English-speaking staff and lots of visitors from abroad; small dogs welcome on your lap downstairs.

roles: Café staff (unnamed)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a café opened 8 February 2022. Reviewers in 2026 describe cheerful staff greeting guests in English and Japanese, many foreign tourists, freshly roasted coffee, and a calm Japanese-modern interior with a tatami-style upper floor.
chef_bio.specialty: Cold brew; espresso soft serve; light-roast single origins.

anecdotes.text: "I ordered the Espresso Soft Serve, and it was incredibly delicious—a hit menu after a long time." — July 2026, on the night of the Gion Festival.
An April 2026 visitor noted English menus and English-speaking staff, and was greeted with a smiling "Good morning".
"Being in the heart of a tourist area, I thought the taste might be secondary, but I was pleasantly surprised by the deep flavor and mild acidity" — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: カフェ、東山区祇園町南側540-2、毎日 7:30〜18:30、予約不可、テイクアウト、15席、座敷あり、小型犬は1階で抱っこなら可、カード・電子マネー可、QR 不可、子ども可、2022年2月8日オープン。口コミ (2026年4月〜10月、英語): 八坂神社の手前、祇園の交差点、グアテマラとエチオピアの浅煎り、水出しコーヒー、カフェラテ、カフェオレ、エスプレッソのソフトクリーム、ホットサンド、猫の形のフレンチトースト、レモンスカッシュは甘め、英語のメニューと英語のスタッフ、海外の客が多い、2階は靴を脱ぐ。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu and English-speaking staff (April 2026); shoes off upstairs; small dogs on your lap downstairs.

kyoto_cafe_kocsi.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a bread café — lunch sets come with all-you-can-eat bread, plus quiche, croutons and baked goods (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_cafe_kocsi.vegan_detail: Ask. A daily soup (e.g. pumpkin, mushroom) and salad come with the bread, but the quiche, pâté and many breads use egg, dairy or meat; no vegan information (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_cafe_kocsi.hours_raw: Monday, Tuesday, Friday, Saturday and Sunday 12:00–18:00; closed Wednesday and Thursday; lunch 12:00–15:00 on weekdays only; hours may change (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog); a short queue on the stairs at opening at weekends (September 2025; October 2026). Order at the table, pay at the counter (September 2025). 20 seats with counter and sofa seating; non-smoking; children welcome (Tabelog). Cards (Tabelog). Takeaway (Tabelog). Second floor of 黄瀬ビル, near Kyoto City Hall; 5 min walk from Karasuma Oike or Shiyakusho-mae stations (Tabelog; October 2025). Opened 11 November 2000 (Tabelog); reopened by September 2026 after a pause (September 2026).
kyoto_cafe_kocsi.notes: [Bread café · near City Hall, all the bread you want] A cosy second-floor café near City Hall, open since 2000 and sister to the popular bakery Année, where lunch means soup of the day, quiche or pâté with salad and refills of dense house bread — about ¥900–2,000. Books, sofas and an old-house feel; one guest found the back counter seats warm on a hot day. Short queues at weekend opening. Lunch on weekdays only. Closed Wednesday and Thursday.

roles: Café staff (unnamed)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: opened 11 November 2000. Reviewers describe it as the sister café of the bakery Année, which opened in 2014 west of Karasuma Oike (October 2025), guests being sent here from Année on a short day (September 2025; September 2026), small breads delivered from a nearby bakery (November 2025), and a reopening reported in September 2026.
chef_bio.specialty: Soup of the day with unlimited bread; quiche.

anecdotes.text: A September 2025 guest who found the sister store Année short of bread that day was directed here, ten minutes' walk away, and would gladly have eaten more of the unlimited bread.
A September 2026 regular came as soon as the reopening was announced and found "the interior and atmosphere are just as I remembered."
"I would have appreciated a few more varieties of bread in the all-you-can-eat selection." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: パン・カフェ、中京区福長町123 黄瀬ビル2F、烏丸御池駅・市役所前駅から徒歩5分、月・火・金・土・日 12:00〜18:00、水・木休み、平日のみランチ12:00〜15:00、予約不可、20席、禁煙、子ども可、カード可、テイクアウト、2000年11月11日オープン。口コミ (2025年9月〜2026年10月、英語): パン屋 Annéeの姉妹店、サラダとパン食べ放題のランチ、日替わりスープのセット900円、キッシュ、パテ、かぼちゃやきのこのスープ、ほうれん草のキッシュ、週末は開店時に階段に行列、2026年9月に再開、奥のカウンター席は暑かったとの声。

cultural_comfort.note: Second floor; order at the table, pay at the counter; cards accepted.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reopened, with reviews through October 2026.

kyoto_cave_de_k.gf_detail: Ask. A wine bar with a custard pancake, sandwiches, fritto and roast beef; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_cave_de_k.vegan_detail: Ask. Wine and champagne by the glass; the food named in reviews — cheese, fritto with shrimp and shirako, roast beef, custard pancake — is not vegan (2026 reviews).
kyoto_cave_de_k.hours_raw: 15:00–24:00; closed Tuesday; hours may change (Tabelog; official site). Reservations accepted — call ahead, as late hours fill (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). A ¥1,100 charge from 17:00 (Tabelog original 17時からはチャージ1100円; official site: 5:00pm〜 チャージ 1,100 yen); the official site also lists 税・サービス料 10%. 12 counter seats and a private room for up to 6, for guests who bring a bottle only; non-smoking; no children (Tabelog). Cards (Tabelog). English menu (Tabelog). Ground floor of ヴァルズビル on Nijo east of Kiyamachi, below Bar K6; 5 min walk from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Opened 24 March 2014 (Tabelog).
kyoto_cave_de_k.notes: [Wine bar · Nijo Kiyamachi, champagne by the glass and a famous pancake] A bright counter wine bar below Bar K6 on Nijo-dori, opening from 3 pm, where champagne and sparkling wine — Krug included — are poured by the glass from magnums, and the signature brûléed custard pancake is the sweet to order. Real dishes too: fritto, roast beef, soup, halved for solo guests. A ¥1,100 charge from 5 pm. Call ahead late at night. No children. Closed Tuesday.

roles: Owner (unnamed) and staff
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: opened 24 March 2014. Per the official site, part of K6 (ksix.jp), whose Bar K6 is upstairs. Reviewers in 2026 describe a calm, friendly owner who explains the wines, a ground floor for wine and an upstairs bar for whisky and spirits, and a theme of wine and desserts.
chef_bio.specialty: Champagne by the glass from magnums; custard pancake.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 guest was steered to a rare dessert wine to go with the pancake, and learned that sweet desserts can make lighter whites taste bitter.
A solo October 2026 diner, hesitating over dishes sized for two, was offered smaller portions of the fritto and roast beef.
Reviewers in August 2026 came down to Cave de K after finding Bar K6 upstairs fully booked — for one reviewer, the third time.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (K6): Cave de K、15:00〜0:00、火曜定休、税・サービス料10%、17時からチャージ1,100円。食べログ: ワインバー・パンケーキ、中京区木屋町二条東入ル ヴァルズビル1F、市役所前駅から5分、月・水〜日 15:00〜24:00、火曜休み、予約可、17時からはチャージ1100円、12席 (カウンター)、個室6名まで (ボトル持ち込みの客のみ)、禁煙、子ども不可、カード可、英語メニュー、2014年3月24日オープン。口コミ (2026年6月〜11月、英語): マグナムのシャンパーニュやスパークリングをグラスで、Krug のアンバサダーの店、名物のパンケーキ (ブリュレのようなカスタード)、じゃがいもと栗のポタージュ990円、フリット2,430円、ローストビーフ2,200円、少なめにもできる、2階は Bar K6、夜遅くは満席が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (Tabelog); ¥1,100 charge from 17:00; call ahead late; no children.

kyoto_kotoshieru_granvia.gf_detail: Ask. French and Italian courses with pasta, bread (focaccia, baguette), butter sauces and desserts; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_kotoshieru_granvia.vegan_detail: Not vegan: set courses of fish, abalone, duck and beef, with butter sauces and dairy desserts (2026 reviews).
kyoto_kotoshieru_granvia.hours_raw: Tuesday to Sunday and holidays 11:30–15:30 (last order 14:30) and 17:30–22:00 (last order 21:00); closed Monday except holidays (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; private hire by phone (Tabelog); queues at opening for lunch (September 2026). 15% service charge (Tabelog original サービス料15％). Dress code smart casual — men are asked not to wear sleeveless shirts or sandals; discounts and promotions not applicable (Tabelog). Lunch course ¥5,500 (October 2026); a ¥10,000 Tabelog course with champagne and wines (October 2026). A dessert-plate message for ¥500 (October 2026). 42 seats plus a 16-seat salon; private room "Grace Salon" for 6–16 from ¥16,800 courses; wheelchair accessible; non-smoking (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR incl. Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). 15th floor of Hotel Granvia Kyoto in the Kyoto Station building, directly connected to JR Kyoto Station (Tabelog; October 2026).
kyoto_kotoshieru_granvia.notes: [French-Italian · Kyoto Station, Hotel Granvia 15F with a view] The Hotel Granvia Kyoto's top-floor restaurant above Kyoto Station, with wide windows over the city and monthly French-Italian courses: a ¥5,500 lunch of appetiser, soup or pasta, a main and dessert, or dinners with abalone pasta, duck and beef fillet. Attentive service that will time courses to your Shinkansen; one October 2026 diner found the food somewhat average for the price. 15% service; smart casual. Closed Monday.

roles: Hotel kitchen and service staff (unnamed)
chef_bio.background: The restaurant of Hotel Granvia Kyoto, on the 15th floor of the Kyoto Station building (2026 reviews; Tabelog address). Reviewers in 2026 describe attentive, well-timed service, monthly-changing menus and the view of Kyoto from the large windows.
chef_bio.specialty: Monthly course with a view; Genovese pasta.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 diner on the ¥10,000 Tabelog course found the food "somewhat average" against high expectations, but the service outstanding — timed around a Shinkansen departure.
"I got a bit lost trying to find this place since the address on Tabelog doesn't mention that it's above Granvia." — October 2026.
A September 2026 couple were moved to a window seat, which delighted the companion.

cultural_comfort.note: Smart casual; 15% service; book ahead; cards, e-money and QR.

kyoto_oagari_teppan.gf_detail: Ask. The signature "French Maiko" okonomiyaki is made with rice flour and dashi — a June 2026 diner called it gluten-free — but wheat yakisoba is cooked on the same teppan and sauces are used throughout (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_oagari_teppan.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the rice-flour batter uses dashi, and most dishes have meat, seafood, egg or cheese (2026 reviews).
kyoto_oagari_teppan.hours_raw: 17:00–23:00 (last orders food 22:00, drinks 22:30); closed Thursday and 26 December–4 January (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Table charge with an appetizer ¥495 (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「サービス料（お通し）あり 495円税込」). 18 seats: 6 at the counter facing the teppan, 3 tables; private hire up to 20 (Tabelog). Cards, IC cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). On the ground floor at the back of a building in a back street near Sanjo Kiyamachi; 3 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn, 4 min from Sanjo Stn (Tabelog; June 2026). Opened 3 December 2025 (Tabelog).
kyoto_oagari_teppan.notes: [Okonomiyaki & teppan · Sanjo Kiyamachi, French twists with wine] A bar-like teppan counter tucked behind a building near Sanjo Kiyamachi, opened in December 2025 and sharing its name with the Wagyu Kazan Oagari shops. The rice-flour "French Maiko" okonomiyaki comes under a cheese sauce and egg yolk, and the rest of the menu runs to squid-ink yakisoba, beef-heart carpaccio, French-style daikon oden and duck steak — all paired with wine. ¥495 table charge. Closed Thursday.

roles: Owner and sommelier (unnamed)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): a hidden dining spot built on rice-flour okonomiyaki and teppanyaki, with wine chosen by a sommelier; opened 3 December 2025. It shares the OAGARI name with the Wagyu Kazan Oagari shops in Gion and Arashiyama (Tabelog). A May 2026 diner praised the owner’s wine selection; a June 2026 diner noted Aesop soap and mouthwash in the restroom.
chef_bio.specialty: French Maiko rice-flour okonomiyaki; black yakisoba.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 diner was satisfied with taste and portions but would not call it the best value for money.
A June 2026 diner described the French Maiko as gluten-free, made with rice flour and dashi, creamy rather than fluffy.
An October 2026 traveller ranked it among the top five restaurants of recent years.

cultural_comfort.note: Book online; order à la carte; ¥495 table charge; cards, IC and QR accepted.

kyoto_nonbee_gion.gf_detail: Ask. Yakitori comes with salt or a soy-based tare; ask for salt (2025–26 reviews). No gluten information.
kyoto_nonbee_gion.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a chicken yakitori bar; vegetables and tofu are grilled on the same grill (July 2025).
kyoto_nonbee_gion.hours_raw: 18:00–3:00 (last order 2:00); closed Sunday and public holidays (Tabelog). Reservations accepted, advised — often fully booked (Tabelog; August 2025, April 2026). Charge ¥330 (Tabelog, Japanese text gives only 「330」). A Tabelog course of 10 skewers ¥3,300 for 2–8 (Tabelog). 16 seats: 8 at the counter and a private room for up to 6; a tight counter (Tabelog; December 2025). Smoking allowed (Tabelog). Cards; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). At the end of a narrow lane off Hanamikoji east of Shinbashi, with a tobacco shop on the corner; 3 min from the Gion bus stop, 7 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; December 2025). Opened 25 November 2019 (Tabelog).
kyoto_nonbee_gion.notes: [Yakitori · Gion, binchotan skewers till 3 a.m.] A small counter at the end of a Gion back lane where morning-fresh chicken goes over binchotan: start with the 10-skewer course (¥3,300) and don't skip the liver, the house pride. Prices are low for Gion, so it books up — reserve. Smoking allowed; ¥330 charge. Open 18:00–3:00, closed Sunday.

roles: Owner and chef (unnamed)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): yakitori grilled over binchotan by a chef trained at a well-known restaurant in Shijo Mibu, with chicken prepared and skewered in-house by the owner; opened 25 November 2019.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 regular waited over ten minutes for the first beer when the tap failed, with only two staff on, and wished bottled beer had been offered at once.
A December 2025 diner found the counter so tight that elbows kept bumping.
A September 2025 diner’s husband, who usually avoids liver, happily ate it.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 焼き鳥・居酒屋・鶏料理、東山区四条通大和大路東入北側347-118、祇園四条駅から徒歩7分、祇園バス停から3分、月〜土 18:00〜翌3:00 (L.O. 2:00)、日曜・祝日休み、予約可、チャージ330円、焼き鳥10本のコース3,300円、16席 (カウンター8、個室6名まで)、喫煙可、カード可、2019年11月25日オープン、朝引きの鶏を備長炭で、Shijo Mibu の名店で修業した料理人、おすすめはきも。口コミ (2023年12月〜2026年7月、英語): 祇園にしては安い、レバー刺し、月見つくね、焼きおにぎり、予約で埋まる、カウンターが狭い、ビールが出るまで10分以上待ったという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; the course is the easiest order; smoking allowed; cards accepted.

kyoto_demachi_rororo.gf_detail: Ask. A bento of small obanzai seasoned with soy, dashi and miso, plus tempura (2026 reviews).
kyoto_demachi_rororo.vegan_detail: Not vegan as served: mostly vegetables, but dressed with niboshi and dashi, with egg and fish in some dishes (July and October 2026). Ask when booking.
kyoto_demachi_rororo.hours_raw: Tue–Thu 11:30–16:00; Fri–Sun lunch 11:30–13:30 and dinner 18:00–20:30; closed Monday and the second and fourth Sundays (Tabelog). Reservations essential — walk-ins are turned away; book by phone, best around 8:00–11:00, as calls during service go to voicemail; the mini kaiseki must be booked by the day before (Tabelog; July–September 2026). No cards or e-money (Tabelog). 15 seats at lunch (a U-shaped counter and two small tables), 9 counter seats at night; shoes off (Tabelog; July 2026). Non-smoking (Tabelog). On Imadegawa-dori, Demachi; 7 min from Demachiyanagi Stn, 2 min from the Aoi Bridge West End bus stop (Tabelog). Opened 25 July 2007 (Tabelog).
kyoto_demachi_rororo.notes: [Obanzai · Demachi, the two-tier vegetable bento] A shoes-off counter on Imadegawa near Demachiyanagi whose ¥1,500 lunch bento — a dozen small dishes of Ohara organic vegetables, each seasoned differently, with clay-pot rice and its crisp crust — is booked solid weeks ahead. Phone in the morning (8–11), since calls go to voicemail during service; the mini kaiseki (¥2,650) adds fish and dessert. Cash only. Closed Monday.

roles: Owner (unnamed); a man runs the floor with a woman in the kitchen (July 2026)
chef_bio.background: Opened 25 July 2007 (Tabelog). A July 2026 diner saw a man, probably the owner, handling the room single-handed with a woman in the kitchen; an August 2026 diner felt the owner’s passion matched the careful cooking.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 group found the room poorly ventilated; eyes hurt and a strong smell clung to clothes for the rest of the day.
An August 2026 diner saw walk-ins turned away even when tables had freed up.
A June 2026 diner loved the variety but thought the portions might be small for some.

kyoto_sushi_ooga_higashiyama.gf_detail: Ask. An omakase of small dishes and nigiri with soy, marinated fish and sauces (2024–26 reviews). No gluten information.
kyoto_sushi_ooga_higashiyama.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish and shellfish sushi omakase (2024–26 reviews).
kyoto_sushi_ooga_higashiyama.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–14:30 and dinner 18:00–20:30; closed Wednesday (Tabelog). Reservation only; omakase course only; cancellation within 48 hours charged 100%; booking released if no contact 30 minutes after the time; children from middle school get the adult menu (Tabelog). 10 counter seats; private hire up to 20 (Tabelog). Cards; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). On the second basement of Six Senses Kyoto, through a door behind the lobby; 3 min from the Higashiyama-Shichijo bus stop, 10 min from Shichijo Stn (Tabelog; 2024–25 reviews). kyoto_sushi_ooga_higashiyama.notes: [Sushi · Higashiyama Shichijo, Sushi Ooga inside Six Senses] The Kyoto counter of Sakai's famously hard-to-book Sushi Ooga, hidden behind a door at the back of the Six Senses Kyoto lobby, two floors down. Ten seats, omakase only: small dishes, then nigiri centred on tuna from the same wholesaler as the original — se-toro, chutoro, otoro — by a young head chef trained at the main shop. Expect ¥30,000–50,000+. Strict 48-hour cancellation. Closed Wednesday.

roles: Head chef (a young apprentice of the Sakai shop; reviewers give the name Sakai, 2024)

Reviewers in 2024 describe the head chef as the Sakai shop’s top apprentice, trained there for seven years and 26 years old (June 2024), and name the chef as Sakai (April and August 2024); a December 2025 diner found the head chef friendly and kind.

anecdotes.text: A June 2024 diner found it underwhelming for the price and the nori not crisp despite being toasted, while liking the young owner’s manner.
An April 2024 diner came on opening day for lunch; Mr. Ooga came from Sakai to greet guests.
A September 2024 diner found the cost performance poor, on the expensive side even by Tokyo standards.

kyoto_meshidokoro_pochi.gf_detail: Ask. Tempura, oden on a bonito-and-flying-fish dashi, saikyo-miso grilled pork and kamameshi; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_meshidokoro_pochi.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options and vegetable tempura is served, but the oden broth is bonito, flying-fish and kombu dashi and most dishes are fish or meat (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_meshidokoro_pochi.hours_raw: 17:00–22:30 (last order 22:00); closed Tuesday (Tabelog). Bookings online or by phone — call even if online shows full (Tabelog). Ordering by smartphone (June 2026). 30 seats: an 11-seat counter around the kitchen and tables upstairs; private rooms for 6–8, or 12–16 by arrangement; children 3 and over; non-smoking with a smoking space; cards, e-money and PayPay (Tabelog). 5 min from Shijo-Karasuma (Tabelog).
kyoto_meshidokoro_pochi.notes: [Izakaya · near Shijo-Karasuma] A calm, grown-up izakaya with a counter around the kitchen, where the stars are the kamameshi rice pots, oden with playful twists and light tempura — plus market-fresh sashimi. About ¥4,000–6,000. Popular: book, or call even if online looks full. Closed Tuesday.

roles: Operator unnamed in the sources
chef_bio.background: Opened 17 April 2023 (Tabelog). Per the operator: fish from Kyoto Central Market every morning; oden dashi from Matsushimaya Honten bonito flakes with flying fish, dried shiitake and Hidaka kombu.

anecdotes.text: The first guest of the evening in March 2026 was surprised by a light clear soup as the starter.
Fully booked by 7:30 pm on a March 2026 night; the octopus kamameshi was the highlight.
An August 2026 pair appreciated the serving chopsticks set out for sharing.

kyoto_gibier_no_nabariya.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a game-meat restaurant — deer, boar, duck, rabbit, bear, carp (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_gibier_no_nabariya.hours_raw: Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri and days after holidays 15:00–21:00; Wed, Sat, Sun, holidays and days before holidays 12:00–21:00 (lunch menu 12:00–15:00); food last order 20:00, drinks 20:15; closing days not fixed (Tabelog). Charge ¥350 per person — Tabelog's Japanese original: "チャージ料 お一人様350円（税込）". In a former coffee shop at the back of a building ground floor, 3 min north of Hankyu Karasuma Stn exit 16 (Tabelog; June and October 2026).
kyoto_gibier_no_nabariya.notes: [Game meat & wine · behind Daimaru near Karasuma] A cosy retro bistro in a former coffee shop serving game that converts sceptics: slow-roasted Ezo deer, boar, duck, rabbit, even bear, plus a four-game lunch plate and venison-cutlet curry. Dinner about ¥4,000–8,000, ¥350 charge; lunch at weekends and Wednesdays. No children after 4 pm.

roles: Chef (unnamed; a September 2026 reviewer saw one chef working)
chef_bio.background: Per the operator: game slow-roasted for about 30 minutes to tame its smell; a lunch menu meant for game beginners. Per a June 2026 reviewer, the room was a coffee shop before it became a game restaurant; a September 2026 regular praises how the hunters process the meat.
chef_bio.specialty: Roast Ezo deer; four-game lunch plate.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 first-timer who had doubts about venison wrote that it was so good it prompted a first-ever Tabelog review.
An April 2026 diner tried koi carpaccio for the first time and found no muddy taste.
After a concert at Kamigamo Shrine, an October 2026 couple ended with rabbit "usamayo" that tasted like tuna.

kyoto_shimogamo_saryo.notes: [Ryotei · Shimogamo, since 1856] A 170-year-old Kyoto ryotei by the Takano River, near Shimogamo Shrine: seasonal kaiseki served in garden-view rooms, with a century-old garden to stroll after. roles: Ryotei (no person named in the sources)
chef_bio.background: Per the operator: founded about 170 years ago, in Ansei 3 (1856), in Shimogamo; a ryotei carrying on Kyoto cuisine and tea kaiseki, with tea rooms such as Sansen-an, garden views from every room, and a history of guests among writers and dignitaries. Besides this main house, our crawl lists 下鴨茶寮 counters at 京都駅ポルタ and ジェイアール京都伊勢丹, and a 2024 press release announced a Matsuya Ginza shop with an eat-in corner.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the operator: "local ingredients, local methods"; traditional technique with modern creativity.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 fan came because two idols had visited on a TV show, and was photographed in the garden by the staff.
A June 2026 lunch guest loved the minazuki tofu enough to want it sold at department stores.

kyoto_toki_hotel_the_mitsui.notes: [Kyoto French · HOTEL THE MITSUI KYOTO by Nijo Castle] The hotel's French dining room, open to non-guests, where chef Tetsuya Asano — formerly executive sous-chef of the Ritz Paris main dining room and Japan's 2027 Bocuse d'Or candidate — builds sauces on a dashi of Fushimi brewing water. Lunch from about ¥12,000, dinner ¥20,000+ (service included). Smart casual; garden views.

chef_bio.chef_name: Tetsuya Asano (romaji, per the operator on Tabelog)
roles: Head chef
chef_bio.background: Per the operator on Tabelog: trained at several renowned restaurants in the Netherlands and France before the Ritz Paris; in 2017 the first Japanese executive sous-chef of the main dining room, overseeing the hotel's restaurants including the two-Michelin-star Espadon with the executive chef; selected as Japan's representative for the Bocuse d'Or 2027. TOKI opened 3 November 2020 (Tabelog). A June 2026 reviewer says it holds a Michelin star; a September 2026 reviewer says it is listed in the Michelin Guide.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the operator: Kyoto ingredients and Kyoto water, with a French "dashi" of Fushimizu.

A birthday guest in October 2026 was looked after by a staff member, Nakaba-san, who also explained the local ingredients.
An August 2026 lunch guest found the menu gave nothing away beforehand — "an experience far beyond your imagination".

kyoto_tempura_tohzan.notes: [Tempura · Kawaramachi-Oike, twelve-seat counter] A twelve-seat tempura counter upstairs by Kyoto City Hall, run by a couple with a little help: the chef fries shrimp, corn and seasonal vegetables to order and explains how to eat each. roles: Chef (not named); a June 2024 diner writes the restaurant "is run by a couple and their staff"
chef_bio.background: Opened 19 September 2018 (Tabelog). "If the background music were selected by a professional, I believe this would become the best restaurant." — July 2024.
"They didn’t even ask if we wanted a refill for our tea, so I don’t think I’ll be coming back." — April 2026.
A July 2025 family brought a child to try real tempura and enjoyed the chef’s funny stories; the tempura bowl was the best they had ever eaten.

kyoto_gion_tsuzaki.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; a sushi and à la carte menu with simmered dishes, tempura in the winter fugu course and red miso soup (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_gion_tsuzaki.vegan_detail: Not vegan: sushi, sashimi, fugu, shrimp and dashi-simmered dishes (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_gion_tsuzaki.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon–Sat 12:00–13:30 (lunch by reservation only) and 18:00–22:00; closed Sunday. A daily otoshi from ¥500 is charged (Tabelog; Japanese original 「つきだし 500円～ ※日替わり」). BYO allowed at ¥2,000 per bottle (Tabelog). 13 seats: 7 at the counter, 6 at sunken tables; smoking allowed (Tabelog), e-cigarettes too (August 2026); cards and e-money, no QR (Tabelog). Opened 24 June 2010 (Tabelog).
kyoto_gion_tsuzaki.notes: [Sushi · Gion Shinbashi, relaxed and smoking-friendly] A thirteen-seat sushi shop near Yasaka Shrine that regulars call welcoming rather than formal: omakase nigiri, then whatever you like à la carte — dancing shrimp, engawa, funazushi — with a strong sake list and fugu in winter. Families return every Obon; one regular has been 27 times. Smoking and e-cigarettes allowed. ¥500+ otoshi. Lunch by reservation; closed Sunday.

roles: Owner, chef and hostess at the counter (2024–2026 reviews); not named
chef_bio.background: Opened 24 June 2010 (Tabelog). Reviewers from 2024 to 2026 describe a friendly chef, owner and hostess, a counter and sunken tables, à la carte ordering beside courses, and a sake list chosen with care; a June 2025 regular on a 27th visit was glad to see the couple again.
chef_bio.specialty: Omakase nigiri; à la carte sushi with sake; winter fugu.

anecdotes.text: A family returns every Obon; in August 2026 they tried the rare funazushi with sake.
"They also allow electronic cigarettes, so if you're looking for a sushi restaurant where you can smoke, I highly recommend this place." — August 2026.
A December 2024 guest’s friend quietly ordered dancing shrimp, still moving, followed by their fried heads; the bill came to about ¥10,000 each with drinks.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ぎをん 津崎、寿司・日本料理・海鮮、東山区新橋通り花見小路東入ル、八坂神社北門から徒歩3分、月〜土 12:00〜13:30 (昼は予約のみ)・18:00〜22:00、日曜休み、つきだし500円〜 (日替わり)、持ち込み1本2,000円、13席 (カウンター7、掘りごたつ6)、喫煙可、カード・電子マネー可、QR不可、2010年6月24日オープン。口コミ (2023年8月〜2026年8月、英語): おまかせ握りのコースとアラカルト、鯛と平目のえんがわ、踊り海老と頭の唐揚げ、ひれ焼き、雲丹、いくら、鮒寿司、冬のふぐのコース (造り、天ぷら、鍋、雑炊)、昼の海鮮ちらし2,000円 (2023年)、日本酒の品揃え、大将と女将と店主が気さく、毎年お盆に来る家族、27回目の常連、電子たばこも可。

cultural_comfort.note: Order from the menu at the counter or take the omakase; book ahead on busy days.

kyoto_edegger_tax_okazaki.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: an Austrian bakery of wheat and rye breads, pretzels, croissants and cakes (official site; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_edegger_tax_okazaki.vegan_detail: Not vegan: butter croissants and Danishes, cream-filled cornets, Sachertorte with cream (2026 reviews); ask about plain breads such as pretzels or rye.
kyoto_edegger_tax_okazaki.hours_raw: Official site and Tabelog: 10:00–18:00; closed Wednesday and Thursday. Products can be reserved; café seats cannot (Tabelog). Take-out is paid first, drinks ordered at the table (October 2026); breads often sell out by lunchtime on holidays (October 2026). Café with a terrace; non-smoking; parking for four cars; cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). No service charge listed on Tabelog. Opened 19 September 2020 (Tabelog).
kyoto_edegger_tax_okazaki.notes: [Austrian bakery-café · Okazaki] The Japanese shop of a Graz court bakery founded in 1569, whose eighth-generation owner entrusted its recipes to a Vienna-trained Japanese baker. Handkaiser rolls, pretzels, rye bread and a giant cream cornet to take away, or Sachertorte and chestnut tart on the terrace. Breads sell out early on holidays. Closed Wednesday and Thursday.

chef_bio.chef_name: 野澤 孝彦 (のざわ・たかひこ, per the official site)
roles: Chef of the Japanese shop, entrusted with the recipes by Robert Edegger (official site)
chef_bio.origin: Born 1972 in 埼玉県上尾市 (official site).
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: Hofbäckerei Edegger-Tax in Graz, founded in 1569, held the Habsburg court warrant; the eighth-generation owner Robert Edegger, in charge since 1992, entrusted the recipes to 野澤 孝彦 and opened the Japanese shop, "from Graz to Kyoto". 野澤 was drawn to Austrian culture through piano lessons, went to Vienna at 22 and trained at the café houses Oberlaa and L. Heiner, learned bread-making at Wandinger in southern Germany, opened Neues in Japan in 1999 and received the recipes from Robert Edegger in 2012. A September 2026 diner remembers the shop near Mansei-bashi in Tokyo and writes that it has moved twice. Opened in Kyoto on 19 September 2020 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Official site: 「いまを生きる伝統」 — a living tradition, not mere repetition.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 visitor recognised the shop from Mansei-bashi in Tokyo years ago, and found it had moved twice before settling in Kyoto.
"The Lauren... it's about 14 cm long! This is the biggest and longest cornet I've ever seen!" — September 2026.
On a three-day weekend in October 2026 most of the bread was gone by lunchtime; the diner had cake on the terrace instead.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (edegger-tax.jp): ホーフベッカライ エーデッガー・タックス、皇帝も愛したパン、王家御用達、1569年創業のグラーツ最古のベーカリー、ハプスブルク帝国の皇帝も認めた、8代目店主ロベルト・エーデッガー氏がウィーンで修行した菓子職人の野澤孝彦シェフに秘伝の技とレシピを託し日本店を開く、グラーツから京都へ、「いまを生きる伝統」、野澤 孝彦 (のざわ・たかひこ) は1972年埼玉県上尾市生まれ、ピアノをきっかけにオーストリア文化に興味、22歳でウィーンへ、Oberlaa・L. Heiner で修行、南ドイツの Wandinger で製パン、1999年に Neues を開業、2012年にレシピを伝授される、ハンドカイザー、キプフェル、ザルツシュタンゲル、クグロフ、カイザークグロフ、ザッハトルテ、シシーブッセル、左京区岡崎成勝寺町3-2、10:00〜18:00、水木定休。食べログ: パン・ケーキ、2020年9月19日オープン、商品の予約は可、席の予約は不可、テラス、駐車場4台、カード・電子マネー・QR可。口コミ (2025年9月〜2026年11月、英語): プレッツェル250円、ハンドカイザー胡麻240円、ライ麦全粒粉600円、クロワッサン360円、14cmのコルネ、デニッシュ、ザッハトルテ、栗のタルト、モンブラン、休日は昼までにパンが売り切れ、東京の万世橋近くから2度移転、客の半分ほどは海外から。

cultural_comfort.note: Pick breads at the counter and pay first; drinks ordered at the table; about half the customers were from overseas (October 2026).

kyoto_atelier_pages.gf_detail: Ask. Financiers, croissants, canelés and cakes are wheat; the gelato and chocolates may suit, but no gluten information is given (official site; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_atelier_pages.vegan_detail: Ask. Butter financiers, croissants and cheesecake are not vegan; some gelato flavours (cacao, coconut) may be dairy-free — no information given (official site; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_atelier_pages.hours_raw: Tabelog: Thu–Tue 10:00–18:00; closed Wednesday; hours may change. Cashless payment only — cards, IC cards and QR (Tabelog). Take-out by mobile order (official site). A booking-only café upstairs opened in February 2024 and a May 2024 notice paused it; the site still links café booking, and a September 2026 diner found the café crowded at weekends. No service charge listed on Tabelog. Opened 20 July 2023 (Tabelog).
kyoto_atelier_pages.notes: [Pâtisserie & gelato · Kawaramachi-Oike] The Kyoto atelier of Ryuji Teshima, whose Restaurant Pages in Paris holds a Michelin star: AOP-butter financiers best warmed at home, chocolates, and gelato that diners say tastes of the fruit and cacao itself, to take away or eat in. Reviewers rave about the gelato and Basque cheesecake; one found the canelé and financier milder than hoped. Cashless only. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.chef_name: 手島 竜司 (Ryuji Teshima, per the official site)
roles: Owner-chef of RESTAURANT PAGES in Paris, whose products this atelier sells (official site)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: began training at 19 in a French restaurant in Kumamoto, qualified as a sommelier at 23, moved to France at 26 and trained at starred restaurants including the then three-star Lucas Carton in Paris; studied meat at Boucherie Hugo Desnoyer and produce at Terroir d’Avenir; opened RESTAURANT PAGES near the Arc de Triomphe in the 16th arrondissement in 2014 at 37; named "Grand Chef de Demain" by Gault&Millau in 2015 and opened the wine bar 116 next door; one Michelin star in 2016, held eight years running; appointed a goodwill ambassador of Kumamoto in 2016; opened ATELIER PAGES KYOTO in July 2023.
chef_bio.philosophy: Official site: an atelier for Paris and Kyoto, two cities of layered history, bringing "new esprit" from a Japanese chef shaped in France.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 "lunch refugee" turned away from two closed restaurants ended up with a ¥1,500 mango-coconut croissant filled with mango, coconut cream and mango pudding — "a delightful calorie bomb".
"It wasn't just a rich chocolate flavor; it truly highlighted the fruity acidity of the cacao itself." — August 2026, on the cacao gelato.
An October 2026 diner found the croffins sugary and less generously filled than in the video.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (atelier-pages.com): ATELIER PAGES、パリと京都に共通する歴史を重ねた街のアトリエ、手島 竜司 (Ryuji Teshima) は熊本県出身、19歳から熊本のフランス料理店で修行、23歳でソムリエ、26歳で渡仏、当時三ツ星の LUCAS CARTON などで修行、BOUCHERIE HUGO DESNOYER と TERROIR D’AVENIR で学ぶ、2014年37歳でパリ16区に RESTAURANT PAGES、2015年ゴーミヨ「未来の巨匠」、隣に BAR A VIN「116」、2016年にミシュラン一つ星 (8年連続)、熊本親善大使、2023年7月 ATELIER PAGES KYOTO オープン、ニコラ・ベルジェのクーベルチュールのショコラ、ジェラート (ショコラ フェルテ82%、ショコラ コロンビア100%、季節のフルーツ＋フロマージュブラン、コーヒー)、AOP バターのフィナンシェ (クラシック、ショコラ)、モバイルオーダー、2階カフェは予約制 (2024年2月に開店、5月に一時休止の告知)。食べログ: 洋菓子・ジェラート・チョコレート、中京区下丸屋町412-3、木〜火 10:00〜18:00、水曜休み、キャッシュレスのみ、2023年7月20日オープン。口コミ (2026年8月〜11月、英語): ジェラート、フィナンシェ、カヌレ、バスクチーズケーキ、クロワッサン、クロッフル450円、マンゴーとココナッツのクロワッサン1,500円、ほうじ茶プリン、週末のカフェは混む、カヌレやフィナンシェは好みが分かれる。

cultural_comfort.note: Order at the counter or by mobile order; cashless only.

kyoto_gion_ishi_soba.gf_detail: Ask. Soba and udon in soy-based dashi with tempura and kakiage; buckwheat noodles usually contain some wheat and no gluten information is published (2024–26 reviews).
kyoto_gion_ishi_soba.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options, but the broth is dashi-based and most bowls add chicken, duck, beef, herring, shrimp or egg; no ingredient list is published (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_gion_ishi_soba.hours_raw: 11:30–19:00 (last order 18:30); closed Wednesday and every other Thursday (Tabelog). Bookings taken; can be a wait at busy times (Tabelog; August 2026). 20 seats: 12 at tables and 8 at the counter; non-smoking; cards; English menu; children welcome (Tabelog). On the 3rd floor of the Gion Ishi building, a stone and gem shop at the foot of the Yasaka Shrine steps, east of the Kyoto Gion Hotel — take the lift at the back of the 1st-floor shop; the 2nd floor is the café Kissa Ishi (Tabelog; 2024–26 reviews). Jazz plays in the room (January 2026). 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_gion_ishi_soba.notes: [Soba · Gion, a quiet room above a stone shop] A calm soba room on the third floor of the Gion Ishi building, a gem and stone shop right below the Yasaka Shrine steps — ride the lift at the back of the shop, past the 2nd-floor café. Firm, cold zaru soba (¥800), a huge kakiage soba, duck or herring soba, and a beef sukiyaki with soba or udon, to jazz in the background. Few tourists find it, though a queue can form. Closed Wednesday and every other Thursday.

roles: Not named in any source found
chef_bio.background: Part of the Gion Ishi building at the foot of the Yasaka Shrine steps: a stone and gem shop on the 1st floor, the café Kissa Ishi on the 2nd and this soba room on the 3rd (2025–26 reviews).

anecdotes.text: A January 2026 visitor was greeted at the 1st-floor shop with a cheerful welcome before taking the lift up to the soba room.
A January 2026 diner was warned the large kakiage soba would take a while and found the bowl covered in freshly fried kakiage.
An August 2026 longtime customer of the shop dislikes queuing with tourists.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ぎおん石 京そば処、そば・うどん・うどんすき、東山区四条祇園石段下、京都祇園ホテルの東側、祇園四条駅から徒歩約5分、11:30〜19:00 (L.O. 18:30)、水曜と隔週木曜休み、予約可、20席 (テーブル12、カウンター8)、禁煙、カード可、英語メニュー、ベジタリアンメニュー、子ども可。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): 天然石の店の3階、2階は喫茶、奥のエレベーター、ざるそば800円、天ぷらそば、かき揚げそば、親子豆腐そば、鴨そば、にしんそば、牛すき焼き、ジャズ。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (Tabelog); take the lift at the back of the stone shop.

kyoto_budoushudou_wine_do.gf_detail: Ask. Lunch is hamburg steak with demi-glace and rice or bread; dinner brings ravioli, pâté and meat; no gluten information is published — the shop asks guests to mention allergies when booking (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_budoushudou_wine_do.vegan_detail: Not vegan: hamburg steaks of beef and duck, prosciutto, foie gras pâté and meat dishes; the obanzai sides have no published ingredients (2026 reviews).
kyoto_budoushudou_wine_do.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–13:30, café 13:30–16:00, dinner 17:00–24:00 (Tabelog lists last orders 23:00 food and 23:30 drinks, but also notes dinner last order 21:30); closed Sunday (Tabelog). No bookings for drinks-only or dessert-only café visits; tell allergies when booking (Tabelog). Dinner charge ¥330 per person (Tabelog’s Japanese original: 「お一人様につきチャージ料330円（税込・ディナータイムのみ）」). 20 seats: 6 at the counter and 14 at tables; cards, transit IC, QUICPay and PayPay (Tabelog). Menu by QR code (July 2026). The owner runs it alone, so large groups may be hard (April and September 2026). Fourth shop down a narrow alley south of the Shijo-Higashinotoin crossing; 2 min from Shijo or Karasuma Stn exit 19 (Tabelog). Opened 14 February 2020 (Tabelog).
kyoto_budoushudou_wine_do.notes: [Wine bar · Shijo-Karasuma, a one-man alley wine bar] A small wine bar down a narrow alley near Shijo-Higashinotoin, run single-handed by a quiet owner. At lunch it is a hamburg-steak shop — ¥1,300 for a 200 g steak with three homemade obanzai, rice and miso soup, or a classic-and-duck tasting for ¥1,700. At night it turns to wine, with prosciutto, foie gras pâté and ravioli, and an all-you-can-drink course. ¥330 charge at dinner. Sister bar: 葡萄酒堂 musica. Closed Sunday.

roles: Owner (the invoice holder), who runs the shop alone (April and September 2026 reviews)
chef_bio.background: The invoice register lists an individual, 川口 真哉, for the shop’s invoice number. Reviewers describe an owner who runs the place alone, reserved but considerate (April 2026), with a well-kept range of wines (March 2026). Opened 14 February 2020 (Tabelog). A sister bar, 葡萄酒堂 musica, appears in the Tabelog crawl.
chef_bio.specialty: Hamburg steak lunch with obanzai; wine.

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 group of four colleagues found the owner running the place alone — a bit reserved but very considerate.
An August 2026 visitor saw a "closed" sign on a Saturday but heard activity inside, asked, and was served lunch.
A March 2026 diner from Osaka found the 100 g hamburgers light, and the duck one a match for red wine.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 葡萄酒堂、ワインバー・イタリアン・日本料理、下京区元悪王子町47-12、烏丸駅・四条駅19番出口から四条東洞院の交差点、東洞院を南へ、パンケーキ店と弁当店の間の路地の4軒目、月〜土・祝 11:30〜13:30・13:30〜16:00・17:00〜24:00、日曜休み、カフェのドリンクのみ・デザートのみの予約不可、アレルギーは予約時に、チャージ330円 (税込・ディナーのみ)、20席 (カウンター6、テーブル14)、カード・交通系IC・QUICPay・PayPay 可、2020年2月14日オープン、インボイス: 川口 真哉 (個人)。口コミ (2026年3〜10月、英語): ハンバーグ定食1,300円 (200g、おばんざい3種、ご飯かパン、味噌汁)、Ishikura-tei のクラシックハンバーグと鴨ネギバーグの食べ比べ1,700円、生ハム3種、フォアグラのパテ、飲み放題のコース、店主が一人で営む。

cultural_comfort.note: One-person shop; QR-code menu; ¥330 dinner charge.

kyoto_kappo_harada.gf_detail: Ask when booking. Seasonal Kyoto kappo with dashi and soy; no gluten information is published (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_kappo_harada.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish-led kappo — ayu, hamo, turtle, shellfish — with dashi (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_kappo_harada.hours_raw: Hours are not published; a July 2025 regular says the shop is closed on Monday, when the owner goes ayu fishing. Reservation only; Tabelog notes it is not strictly introduction-only but bookings may be hard without one. AMEX accepted; non-smoking (Tabelog). Run by the owner and the owner’s wife with a part-time student (September 2026). Formerly on Kawaramachi-dori (July 2025); now off Nakamachi-dori north of Ebisugawa, about 400 m from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog). Most diners spend ¥15,000–30,000 (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_kappo_harada.notes: [Kappo · Marutamachi, the angler chef's ayu] A small kappo near the Imperial Palace, formerly on Kawaramachi, where the owner — a keen angler who fishes for ayu on the weekly day off — cooks seasonal Kyoto dishes with the chef’s wife serving. Summer is the time: live ayu as sashimi and double-grilled until you can eat it bones and all, a side-by-side of wild and Lake Biwa ayu, and ayu rice to finish; spring brings young ayu and pea rice, autumn matsutake. Hard to book without an introduction; about ¥15,000–30,000. Closed Monday per regulars.

roles: Owner-chef (not named) and the owner’s wife, the okami, with a part-time student (September 2026)
chef_bio.background: A July 2025 regular has known the restaurant since it was on Kawaramachi-dori and says the owner, an expert angler, goes ayu fishing on Mondays, the regular day off, lately at Amano in Nara; a September 2026 diner says the couple caught the day’s live ayu in a river in Wakayama. A May 2026 diner praises the chef’s craft and the okami’s attentive service. Many guests are regulars (September 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Ayu, live and grilled twice; ayu rice.

anecdotes.text: A July 2025 regular trusts the owner’s word that the best ayu comes in the second week of July and visits every year then.
An August 2026 regular compared wild Tomita River ayu with farmed Lake Biwa ayu and found the wild one cleaner and more intense.
A September 2026 first-timer from Kanto, among mostly regulars, was warmly welcomed and finally understood hamo.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 割烹 はらだ、日本料理、中京区中町通夷川上ル鉾田町290、神宮丸太町駅から396m、完全予約制 (完全紹介制ではないが紹介がないと予約が難しいことも)、カード (AMEX) 可、禁煙。口コミ (2026年8月、日本語): お盆明け、八寸、天草産の天然スッポンの椀物、富田川の天然鮎と琵琶湖の養殖鮎の食べ比べ、出汁を入れず塩と酒だけの天然鮎の炊き込みご飯。英語の口コミ (2025〜2026年): 以前は河原町通、店主は釣りの名人で休みの月曜に鮎釣り、2度焼きの鮎、ぼたん鱧、豆ご飯、松茸の土瓶蒸し、店主と奥さんと学生アルバイト。

kyoto_hakubi.notes: [Chinese · Higashiyama, 25 small dishes in an old townhouse] A modern Chinese restaurant in an old Kyoto townhouse south of Yasaka Shrine, opened in November 2024. Michelin-listed. 10% service; a ¥3,000 water charge if you order no drinks. Two dinner seatings.

roles: Chef (official site); operator 株式会社ｐａｎｇａｅａ (the invoice holder)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: chef 佐藤 廉歩 honed skills in Ginza and Nishi-Azabu, and cooks traditional Chinese methods with a modern sense; the restaurant offers a course themed on the Manhan banquet, Kyoto ingredients, wine and Chinese-tea pairings chosen by a sommelier, and a cellar of over 500 wines beneath the old townhouse. The invoice number belongs to 株式会社ｐａｎｇａｅａ (NTA corporate-number site). Listed in the Michelin Guide (official site news, April 2025; July 2026 review). Opened 10 November 2024 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: each plate brings the chef’s own sense to traditional methods and carefully chosen Kyoto produce.
chef_bio.specialty: Manhan-themed 25-dish course; shark fin; Peking duck.

kyoto_tousuiro_gion.gf_detail: Some GF options: two gluten-free kaiseki courses, 清水G.F. and 六波羅G.F. (¥13,000), made without wheat flour and with wheat-free seasonings, tofu dengaku replacing nama-fu; book at least three days ahead. The regular courses use nama-fu (wheat gluten) and fried dishes. Cross-contact in the shared kitchen is not addressed — ask (official site).
kyoto_tousuiro_gion.vegan_detail: Some vegan options: the 六波羅 course (¥12,000) uses no meat, fish, egg or dairy, and its dashi uses no niboshi or katsuobushi; a gluten-free version exists. Other courses include fish and Kyoto chicken (official site).
kyoto_tousuiro_gion.hours_raw: Official site (Gion shop page): lunch 11:30–15:00 and dinner 17:00–22:00 Monday–Saturday, dinner to 21:30 on Sundays and holidays (elsewhere on the page 21:00); last entry 20:00; no fixed closing day, closed over New Year. Tabelog gives 11:30–14:00 and 17:00–21:30 Monday–Saturday, 12:00–20:30 Sundays and holidays. Reservations accepted, advised (Tabelog; December 2025). Prices include tax and service (official site). Cards: VISA, JCB, AMEX, Diners (Tabelog). 50 seats, including a counter over a sunken hearth and the 古蔵庵, a converted storehouse for up to 8 (Tabelog; official site; December 2025). Non-smoking (Tabelog). On Higashioji north of Matsubara, near Yasaka Shrine, Kodai-ji and Kiyomizu-dera; 15 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (official site).
kyoto_tousuiro_gion.notes: [Tofu kaiseki · Higashioji, vegan and gluten-free courses] The Gion branch of a Kyoto tofu restaurant (the other is on Kiyamachi), in an old machiya with a converted storehouse room, between Yasaka Shrine and Kiyomizu-dera. Every course centres on refillable oboro yudofu, with dengaku, yuba and soy-milk dishes around it, from a ¥5,000 lunch. Unusually, there is a fully plant-based course, 六波羅 (no meat, fish, egg, dairy or fish dashi), and gluten-free versions of two courses — book these three days ahead. Open daily.

roles: Head chef (unnamed), per the official site
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: 豆水楼 has two shops, on Kiyamachi (a Taisho-era townhouse on the Kamo River, with a summer yuka) and in Gion (a machiya with a storehouse room, 古蔵庵). The site says gluten-free courses were started in response to many requests, mostly from visitors from abroad. A February 2025 regular has come for 22 years.
chef_bio.philosophy: Tofu kaiseki in a traditional machiya; the vegetarian 六波羅 is presented as a new Kyoto tofu kaiseki (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Oboro yudofu; vegetarian and gluten-free tofu kaiseki.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 regular of the Kiyamachi shop noticed that Gion serves the tofu as hot yudofu rather than cold, and enjoyed it in the air-conditioning.

kyoto_hachidaime_gihey_gion.notes: [Rice · Yasaka Shrine, breakfast built on the rice] The restaurant of a Kyoto rice merchant, right in front of Yasaka Shrine, where the star is the white rice — cooked in pots, refilled as often as you like, then served as crunchy okoge and finally as chazuke. A grilled-fish set (¥1,980–2,480) carries it. Book a breakfast slot: you order outside ten minutes early and have 50 minutes at the table. Dinner Friday–Sunday only.

kyoto_gion_kani_o_kurau.gf_detail: Ask. Crab courses with sashimi, grilled and shabu-shabu crab, crab-miso in the shell, crab bowls with dashi, zosui and ramen; no gluten information (official site; 2025–2026 reviews).

The official site gives lunch 12:00–17:00 and dinner 17:00–22:00, closed irregularly. Reservation only; courses only for guests of junior-high age and up (Tabelog). Lunch courses ¥12,000 and ¥14,000 (March–May 2026); a lunch-only Kasumi crab bowl set (official site, January 2026); seasonal full courses (official site). kyoto_gion_kani_o_kurau.notes: [Crab · Gion by Chion-in, live crab from Hyogo] A crab-only restaurant near Yasaka Shrine run by a Kasumi crab wholesaler (in business since 1941) that trucks live crabs from Shibayama and Kasumi ports and cooks each to order: Matsuba (Shibayama) crab in winter, Benizuwai in spring, hairy crab in summer — as sashimi, grilled, shabu-shabu and zosui. Lunch courses are about ¥12,000–14,000, or try the crab bowl finished with dashi. Reviews range from "worth the price" to a March 2026 diner who felt overcharged and was served Kasumi crab instead of the Shibayama on the menu. Reservation only.

roles: Owner (unnamed) and staff
chef_bio.background: Per the official site and Tabelog: a crab wholesaler at the Shibayama and Kasumi fishing ports since 1941 (Tabelog EN gives "Kani Nakaori Kaneni", supplying ryokans and restaurants in Kasumi), focusing on the "Shibayama crab" brand of top-graded Matsuba crab, opened this Gion restaurant in February 2024; crabs are kept alive in tanks at the port and delivered by the company's own trucks. An August 2026 reviewer found the owner kind.
chef_bio.philosophy: "Live, ultimate crab" — crabs alive until just before cooking (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Live Matsuba crab; crab bowl with crab-miso shell.

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 guest on the ¥14,000 lunch course was surprised at the price, was served Kasumi crab although the menu said Shibayama, found the meat too soft, and wrote: "I really don't want to go back to this restaurant again. However, the staff were nice."
A December 2025 father, whose family crab trip had been cancelled, brought the daughters here instead and ate two servings of Kasumi Matsuba crab.
"Towards the end, I started to feel a bit overwhelmed by the crab (laughs)" — August 2026, on the full course.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 祇園 かにを喰らう、兵庫の香住・柴山漁港から自社便で届く「活極蟹」、食事の直前まで生きている蟹を調理する活蟹料理の専門店、八坂神社・知恩院の近く、柴山・香住漁港で1941年創業の蟹仲買人、ブランド「柴山がに」、蟹以外の魚介は出さない、刺身・焼き・しゃぶ・雑炊、活柴山がに (松葉がに) コース、活香住ガニコース、香住ガニ丼と蟹味噌甲羅焼の「香住御膳」(ランチ限定)、Hokkaido の毛蟹フルコース、東山区林下町434 EXIT祇園ビル1F、昼の部12:00〜17:00、夜の部17:00〜22:00、不定休。食べログ: かに・海鮮・日本料理、11:30〜15:00・17:00〜22:00 (料理L.O.20:00)、祝日の翌日休み、完全予約制、中学生以上でコースを注文する客のみ、サービス料無し、17席、個室6名、禁煙、カード可、2024年2月オープン。口コミ (2025年12月〜2026年8月、英語): ランチコース12,000円・14,000円、クッペのランチ、蟹丼に出汁、抹茶プリン、値段の割にという声 (2026年3月)、店主は親切。

cultural_comfort.note: Reservation only; courses; crab shelled for you; cards accepted.

existence.note: Official site with news dated April 2026; reviews through August 2026.

kyoto_gion_ebata.gf_detail: Ask. A yakiniku course with tare and seasoned meats, kimchi, a beef-roast salad and curry to finish; no gluten information (2023–2026 reviews).
kyoto_gion_ebata.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a meat course of beef cuts and offal grilled at the counter (Tabelog; 2023–2026 reviews).
kyoto_gion_ebata.hours_raw: Tuesday to Sunday 18:00–23:00, last entry 21:00; closed Monday (Tabelog). Reservation only; one omakase course (Tabelog; 2024 reviews). 14 counter seats; private hire up to 20; non-smoking; no children (Tabelog). Cards (Tabelog). At the back of EXIT祇園 on the ground floor, opposite the Chion-in entrance — hard to find the first time; 7 min walk from Gion-Shijo or Higashiyama stations (Tabelog; March 2023; May 2025). Opened 1 June 2021 (Tabelog).
kyoto_gion_ebata.notes: [Yakiniku · Gion opposite Chion-in, grilled for you at the counter] The Gion counter of a long-loved Kitano Hakubaicho hormone house: one omakase course of beef and offal grilled in front of you and served at just the right moment — fresh tongue, Chateaubriand, abomasum with green onion — ending with a curry many ask seconds of. About ¥10,000–15,000; drinks are Gion-priced. Chatty owner and staff, but one 2024 newcomer felt out of place among regulars. Hidden at the back of the building. No children. Closed Monday.

roles: Owner (unnamed) and staff
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: the owner of a popular, long-established yakiniku restaurant in Kitano Hakubaicho opened this Gion shop, serving one omakase course of cuts grilled at the counter; opened 1 June 2021. A November 2024 reviewer recalls the parent Ebata near Senbon Imadegawa, famous for gyū-ranegi. Reviewers describe an entertaining manager (July 2025), owner and staff who talk with regulars and first-timers (March 2023), and "the couple running the restaurant" (March 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: A traditional hormone house's flavours served as a counter course (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Omakase meat course; curry to finish.

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 visitor found the couple running the restaurant friendly and chatty with tourists, and asked for a second helping of the closing curry.
"Last time, I ended up eating three bowls of rice early on, which made the later part of the meal quite difficult, so this time I practiced some moderation (laughs)." — July 2025.
"Perhaps it was just coincidence, but it felt a bit awkward as we were the only newcomers among regulars. Also, being in Gion, the drinks were understandably pricey." — May 2024.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 焼肉、東山区林下町434 EXIT祇園1F、祇園四条駅・東山駅から徒歩7分、火〜日 18:00〜23:00 (最終入店21:00)、月曜休み、完全予約制、14席 (カウンター)、貸切20名まで、禁煙、子ども不可、カード可、2021年6月1日オープン、北野白梅町の老舗焼肉店の店主が祇園に開いた店、おまかせコースのみ、目の前で焼く、肉割烹。口コミ (2023年3月〜2026年3月、英語): 姉妹店の千本今出川のえばた、サラダとキムチ、タン、ローストビーフのサラダ、シャトーブリアン、ギアラのねぎ、締めのカレーとスープ、知恩院の入口の向かい、建物の奥で見つけにくい、店主とスタッフの会話、夫婦で営む (2026年3月)、常連ばかりで気まずかったとの声 (2024年5月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Reservation only; one course grilled for you; at the back of the building; no children; cards accepted.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through March 2026.

kyoto_here_coffee.gf_detail: Ask. Coffee and tea alongside canelé, croissants, sandwiches and a house pudding; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_here_coffee.vegan_detail: Ask. Lattes can be made with oat milk (official Instagram feed), and black coffee and tea are plant-based, but the pudding, canelé and pastries use egg and dairy (official site; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_here_coffee.hours_raw: Daily 9:00–18:00, irregular closures; hours may change (Tabelog). No reservations; order at the counter and you are called to collect (Tabelog; October 2026). Busy with visitors from abroad at times (August–September 2026). Cards and e-money; no QR (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Ground floor of the hotel 椛 京都三条, between Karasuma and Karasuma Oike stations; 10 min walk from Nijojo-mae Stn (Tabelog; October 2026). Opened 27 July 2019 (Tabelog).
kyoto_here_coffee.notes: [Coffee · Sanjo near Karasuma Oike, opens at 9] A spacious, concrete-walled café on the ground floor of a hotel near Karasuma Oike, built around a big shared table: single-origin espresso and fruity iced lattes, a firm house pudding with vanilla ice cream (¥650), and a chewy canelé. Coffee and tea run about ¥400–500. Popular with visitors from abroad, so busy at times. Open daily 9:00–18:00.

roles: Café staff (unnamed)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: opened 27 July 2019. Per the official site: the brand also runs here Kyoto kiosk and shops in Tainan and Shanghai, marked its seventh anniversary, and is recruiting staff. Reviewers in 2026 describe staff who explain the coffees attentively and a large open table under exposed concrete.
chef_bio.specialty: Single-origin espresso and latte; pudding; canelé.

anecdotes.text: "The iced latte here is truly delicious! If you love single-origin café lattes, you must visit this place." — September 2026.

An October 2026 guest, back for a second visit after loving the canelé, ordered the pudding and found the price justified by the vanilla-bean ice cream and portion; only the coffee could have been hotter.
"During certain times, it can get quite crowded with inbound tourists, which might not be ideal for those looking to relax alone." — August 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: here、here Kyoto kiosk、Tainan と Shanghai の店舗、7周年、スタッフ募集、オーツミルクのラテ。食べログ: カフェ、中京区姉西洞院町524 椛 京都三条1F、二条城前駅から徒歩10分、毎日 9:00〜18:00、不定休、予約不可、禁煙、カード・電子マネー可、QR 不可、2019年7月27日オープン。口コミ (2026年8月〜10月、英語): 烏丸駅と烏丸御池駅の間、ホテルの1階、コンクリート打ち放しで大きなテーブル、エチオピアのエスプレッソ400円、カフェラテ、アイスラテ、コーヒーと紅茶は500円ほど、オーガニックのグリーンルイボス450円、プリン650円 (バニラアイス付き)、カヌレ、クロワッサン、サンドイッチ、海外の客が多く混む時間がある。

cultural_comfort.note: Order at the counter and collect when called; cards and e-money.

existence.note: Official site and Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_sake_hall_masuya.gf_detail: Ask. Creative izakaya dishes — kara-age, fried octopus and chicken nanban with tartar, corn tempura, spring rolls, yuba pizza, gratin, chilled soba — beside sashimi and tofu; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_sake_hall_masuya.vegan_detail: Ask. Tofu, ginkgo nuts and some vegetable dishes appear, but most dishes are fish, chicken, beef or cheese; no vegan information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_sake_hall_masuya.hours_raw: Monday, Tuesday and Thursday 17:00–22:30; Friday and the day before a holiday 17:00–23:30; Saturday 15:00–23:30; Sunday 15:00–22:30; holidays 15:00–23:00; closed Wednesday, with other closures posted on Instagram (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; seating type (counter or table) may change on the day; same-day bookings possible (Tabelog; September 2026). An otoshi of ¥450 — a small dish with a glass of sake (Tabelog original 付き出し料金450円; August and October 2026). 40 seats at the counter, tables and private rooms (private rooms for courses from ¥6,500); a standing area; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible (Tabelog; August 2026). Cards, e-money and QR incl. Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). A renovated townhouse with a courtyard on Takoyakushi east of Karasuma; 3 min walk from Karasuma or Shijo stations (Tabelog).
kyoto_sake_hall_masuya.notes: [Sake hall · Takoyakushi Karasuma, 40 sakes in a townhouse] A renovated townhouse near Shijo Karasuma turned into a sake hall: forty-odd sakes from across Japan, poured by the half-gō or in tasting flights, with knowledgeable staff to guide you, and inventive snacks — octopus or kara-age with shibazuke tartar, yuba pizza, fig and blue-cheese spring rolls. The ¥450 otoshi includes a glass of sake. Counter, tables, a standing area and a courtyard; open from 3 pm at weekends. Drinks can add up. Closed Wednesday.

roles: Staff (unnamed)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a renovated Kyoto townhouse with a courtyard, more than 40 sakes chosen from across Japan and changing daily, creative Japanese dishes, and weekend daytime drinking. Reviewers in 2026 describe knowledgeable, younger staff, a sake list organised by type, and staff who phoned a guest about a forgotten umbrella.
chef_bio.philosophy: Casual yet authentic sake, easy for beginners (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 guest who left a folding umbrella behind was promptly phoned by the staff on the number given when booking.
"I started with a Japanese sake highball, and to my surprise, the appetizer came with a small cup of sake as well." — August 2026.
"The drinks were a bit on the pricey side, but the food was so good that I plan to visit again." — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 日本酒バー・居酒屋・日本料理、中京区蛸薬師通烏丸東入ル一蓮社町298-2 1F、烏丸駅・四条駅から徒歩3分、月・火・木 17:00〜22:30、金・祝前日 17:00〜23:30、土 15:00〜23:30、日 15:00〜22:30、祝日 15:00〜23:00、水曜休み (ほかの休みはインスタで)、予約可、付き出し料金450円、40席 (カウンター、テーブル、個室)、立ち飲みあり、禁煙、車椅子可、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、京町家を改装、中庭、全国から選んだ日本酒40種以上、半合から、飲み比べ、週末は昼飲み、宴会コース。口コミ (2026年8月〜10月、英語): 付き出しに日本酒が一杯、たこの唐揚げと柴漬けタルタル、とうもろこしの天ぷら、湯葉のピザ、カレータルタルのチキン南蛮、茄子のグラタン、刺身の盛り合わせ、無花果とアボカドとブルーチーズの春巻き、銀杏、豆腐、茶碗蒸し、霜降り牛の冷やしそば、Akabu、Hanayuki、スタッフが詳しい、忘れた傘を電話で知らせてくれた、酒はやや高め。

cultural_comfort.note: Ask staff to guide a sake flight; ¥450 otoshi with sake; cards, e-money and QR.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_est_pizzeria_gion.gf_detail: Ask. A pizzeria of wheat-dough Neapolitan pizza and fresh pasta, with fried starters; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_est_pizzeria_gion.vegan_detail: Ask. About 30 pizzas, mostly with cheese, plus meat and seafood starters (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_est_pizzeria_gion.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–14:00 and dinner 17:30–22:30 (last order); closed Sunday and public holidays (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; courses must be booked ahead, arriving by 18:00 (Tabelog). No service charge or cover (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「サービス料・チャージ料なし」). 19 seats: 6 at a solid-wood counter facing the open kitchen, 8 at tables and a private room for 4–5 (Tabelog; July 2026). Non-smoking; cards and IC cards, no QR (Tabelog). Behind a hidden entrance in a Gion lane, 6 min from Gion-Shijo Stn exit 7 (Tabelog). Opened 27 October 2020 (Tabelog).
kyoto_est_pizzeria_gion.notes: [Pizza & Italian · Gion, wood-fired pizza behind a hidden door] A Gion pizzeria with a solid-wood counter facing a custom wood-fired oven, where prize-winning pizzaioli bake around 30 Neapolitan pizzas — the bufalina is a favourite — alongside fresh pasta, starters and a deep, Burgundy-heavy cellar. Lunch is a casual ¥3,000–4,000; dinners à la carte run higher, and a couple of reviewers found value only fair. No service charge. Closed Sunday.

roles: Chef and pizzaioli (unnamed in the sources)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): Neapolitan pizza from a custom wood-fired oven by craftsmen who took first place in the Japan representative qualifiers, and fresh pasta by an award-winning chef; opened 27 October 2020. An August 2025 diner noted a pizzaiolo with experience in Italy.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 diner loved the porcini and fried squid but found the value not as good as expected.
A June 2025 lunch guest found the margherita delicious but felt something was missing.
A July 2026 diner found aged Burgundies in the walk-in cellar at prices now hard to match.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: イタリアン・ピザ・パスタ、東山区祇園町北側347-147 1F、祇園四条駅7番出口から徒歩6分、昼 11:30〜14:00・夜 17:30〜22:30 (L.O.)、日曜・祝日休み、予約可 (コースは要予約、18時までに来店)、サービス料・チャージ料なし、19席 (カウンター6、テーブル8、個室)、禁煙、カード・交通系IC可、2020年10月27日オープン、特注の薪窯のナポリピッツァ、日本代表選考会で1位の職人、約30種のピッツァ、手打ちの生パスタ、高さ3m のワインセラー。口コミ (2025年5月〜2026年10月、英語): bufalina、マルゲリータ、クアトロ・フォルマッジ、ポルチーニのフライ、とうもろこしのスープとキャビア1,400円、ブルゴーニュ中心のワイン、昼は3,000〜4,000円、コスパはいまひとつという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Order pizza à la carte; book courses ahead; cards and IC cards.

kyoto_kyoya_kiyomizu_gion_shinbashi.gf_detail: Ask. Oden in kombu-and-dashi broth, obanzai, sashimi and tempura, seasoned with soy (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_kyoya_kiyomizu_gion_shinbashi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the Kyoto oden and obanzai are made with dashi (Tabelog).
kyoto_kyoya_kiyomizu_gion_shinbashi.hours_raw: 16:00–22:30 (last order 22:00) daily; closed 31 December–3 January (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; two guests are usually seated at the counter; cancellation 50% the day before, 100% on the day; seating may be limited to 2 hours when busy (Tabelog). No cover charge (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「チャージ料無し」). Courses from about ¥5,000, ¥7,500 with 90 minutes of all-you-can-drink, and an obanzai, oden and sashimi set for two ¥8,800 (2025–26 reviews). 48 seats: a counter on the ground floor, tatami and private rooms with alcoves upstairs for 3–8, whole-floor use for 18–24 (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews). Cards, IC cards, e-money and QR, including Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). On Shinbashi-dori east of Hanamikoji, Gion; 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog). Opened 14 March 2016 (Tabelog).
kyoto_kyoya_kiyomizu_gion_shinbashi.notes: [Obanzai & oden izakaya · Gion Shinbashi, a 150-year-old machiya] One of four Kyoya Kiyomizu izakaya, this one in a renovated Gion Shinbashi townhouse with a counter downstairs and tatami rooms above. Order the obanzai platter, Kyoto oden in a gentle kombu dashi, yuba sashimi and nama-fu dengaku, with Kyoto sake. Courses from about ¥5,000, good value for Gion. Open 16:00–22:30 daily; 2-hour limit when busy.

roles: Restaurant of the Kyoya Kiyomizu group; staff unnamed
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): an izakaya in a fully renovated Kyoto machiya over 150 years old, serving obanzai, Kyoto oden all year, yuba, nama-fu and Kyoto vegetables with local sake; opened 14 March 2016. Tabelog lists three other Kyoya Kiyomizu shops — Kiyamachi, Yanagibaba honke and Nishi-Nishikikoji.

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 regular found value had changed a little since earlier visits but still a safe choice under ¥10,000 in Gion.
A September 2026 diner on the ¥7,500 all-you-can-drink course found each type of drink limited to one brand.
A December 2025 year-end party sat on chairs at tables in the upstairs tatami room, easy on the knees.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋・おでん・豚しゃぶ、東山区新橋通花見小路東入ル2丁目橋本町416、祇園四条駅から徒歩5分、毎日16:00〜22:30 (L.O. 22:00)、12月31日〜1月3日休み、予約可 (2名はカウンター)、キャンセル料 前日50%・当日100%、混雑時は2時間制、チャージ料無し、48席 (座敷、床の間付きの個室、カウンター)、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、2016年3月14日オープン、築150年以上の京町家を改装、おばんざい、通年の京おでん、湯葉、生麩、京野菜、地酒。口コミ (2025年8月〜2026年10月、英語): おばんざいの盛り合わせ、刺身、だし巻き、生麩田楽、生湯葉の刺身、鱧、コース約5,000円、飲み放題付き7,500円、2人用セット8,800円、飲み放題は銘柄が少ないという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Book online; courses or à la carte; cards, IC and QR accepted.

kyoto_shokudo_hokage.gf_detail: Ask. Japanese dishes with dashi and soy, including agedashi sesame tofu and fried horse mackerel (2024–26 reviews). No gluten information.
kyoto_shokudo_hokage.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the vegetable kuzu-hiki and takikomi rice are made with dashi, and fish and meat dishes dominate (2024–26 reviews).
kyoto_shokudo_hokage.hours_raw: Tue–Sat 17:00–21:30; Sun 13:00–20:00; closed Monday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; same-day bookings sometimes possible (Tabelog; October 2024). Clay-pot rice takes about 30 minutes, so order it early (July 2022). 10 counter seats, some with a sunken footwell at the back (Tabelog; September 2024). Non-smoking; cards, no e-money or QR (Tabelog). On Kawaramachi-dori north of Marutamachi, opposite the prefectural medical university; 5 min from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog; June 2023).
kyoto_shokudo_hokage.notes: [Japanese bistro · Kawaramachi Marutamachi, one cook and a clay pot] A ten-seat counter north of Marutamachi run by a single cook, with a long seasonal à la carte list — sashimi, vegetables in kuzu sauce, agedashi sesame tofu — and rice cooked to order in a clay pot (order it first; it takes half an hour), perhaps shirasu and shiso or sakura shrimp and corn. Gentle, careful cooking for about ¥5,000–10,000. Closed Monday; Sunday from 13:00.

roles: Owner-cook (unnamed), running the counter alone (2024–26 reviews)
chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe the restaurant as run single-handed by the owner (February 2024, July and September 2026), with a pace that keeps up despite that (July 2026); a February 2024 visitor was sent by the chef of a popular restaurant.
chef_bio.specialty: Clay-pot takikomi gohan; seasonal vegetable kuzu-hiki.

anecdotes.text: A March 2024 diner thought 1.5 go of bamboo-shoot rice too much for one, then finished it.
A September 2026 diner asked about the dry lemon sour and learned it uses domestic green lemons.
A July 2022 visitor saw the notice that the rice takes about 30 minutes and ordered sake tastings while waiting.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋・日本料理、上京区河原町通丸太町上る出水町273-1、神宮丸太町駅から徒歩5分、火〜土 17:00〜21:30、日 13:00〜20:00、月曜休み、予約可、10席、禁煙、カード可。口コミ (2022年7月〜2026年9月、英語): 店主一人で営むカウンター、季節のアラカルト、土鍋の炊き込みご飯 (約30分、しらすと大葉、桜海老ととうもろこし、鶏ごぼう、蛸、筍)、季節の野菜の葛引き、揚げ出し胡麻豆腐、鯵、豚の角煮、日本酒の飲み比べ、国産レモンのレモンサワー。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; order the clay-pot rice early; Japanese menu; cards accepted.

kyoto_udon_shiki.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: handmade wheat udon from four domestic flours, with wheat-batter tempura (2026 reviews).
kyoto_udon_shiki.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the broth is a bonito dashi (Tabelog).
kyoto_udon_shiki.hours_raw: Lunch 11:00–15:00 (last order 14:30) and dinner 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:30), daily (Tabelog). Not taking reservations for now — come in person and join the waiting list by QR code or app; waits of 30 minutes to over an hour (Tabelog; September–October 2026). May close early when the noodles sell out (September 2026). 37 seats: 9 at the counter, 28 at tables; noodle-making room and waiting area upstairs (Tabelog; October 2026). Non-smoking; cards, IC cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). In a quiet residential lane, so you cannot queue outside; 8 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog; October 2026). Opened 3 December 2025 (Tabelog).
kyoto_udon_shiki.notes: [Udon · near Kawaramachi, chewy handmade udon and crisp tempura] A modern machiya-style udon shop opened in December 2025, with a noodle-making room upstairs. The firm, chewy udon comes cold with big shrimp and vegetable tempura, in curry, or as a cheese-and-yolk carbonara; about ¥1,500–2,400. No bookings — sign up on the waiting list (often an hour in the evening) and wander off. Some found the broth and service uneven. Open daily.

roles: Udon shop; staff unnamed
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): freshly made, chewy udon with a rich bonito dashi and seasonal vegetable tempura, made in a noodle room on the second floor; opened 3 December 2025. An August 2026 reviewer says the restaurant has roots in Roppongi and uses four domestic wheat flours.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 diner, first in at 17:00, waited until 17:20 for orders to be taken and for water, though the tempura was outstanding.
An August 2026 diner liked the chewy noodles but found the broth a poor match and the egg tempura overcooked.
An October 2026 diner waited 65 minutes on a Tuesday night and advised checking in well ahead.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 日本料理・うどん・鍋、下京区丸屋町415-23、京都河原町駅から徒歩8分、毎日 11:00〜15:00 (L.O. 14:30)・17:00〜23:00 (L.O. 22:30)、新規予約は受けていない (直接来店)、37席 (カウンター9、テーブル28)、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、2025年12月3日オープン、2階に製麺室、もちもちの手打ちうどんと濃い鰹出汁、季節の野菜の天ぷら。口コミ (2026年8〜10月、英語): 天ぷらぶっかけ1,650円、和風カレーうどん1,650円、鍋焼きカレーうどん2,280円、六本木うどん2,400円、カルボナーラうどん、国産小麦4種、アプリで順番待ち (1時間以上)、麺がなくなり次第終了、出汁が合わないという声。

kyoto_nichijo_sahan.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; one set meal of the day with simmered dishes in soy-based sauces, miso soup, rice and pickles (2026 reviews).
kyoto_nichijo_sahan.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the day’s main has been chicken meatballs, minced-meat sauce or marinated horse mackerel, with miso soup (2026 reviews).
kyoto_nichijo_sahan.hours_raw: Tabelog: Thu–Tue 12:00–15:00 and 18:00–21:00; closed Wednesday; hours may change. No reservations; queues of up to 30–45 minutes at busy times (June and October 2026). 18 seats: tables, a sofa for 4–5, a small counter; third floor of a building, hard to find (2026 reviews). Smoking area; no smoking at lunch (Tabelog). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). No service charge listed on Tabelog.
kyoto_nichijo_sahan.notes: [Set meals · Sanjo-Takakura, one man and one soup, three dishes] Up three floors among antiques, a quiet owner cooks and serves alone: one ¥1,000 set a day — a simmered main, two small sides, brown rice, miso soup, pickles — gentle, vegetable-rich Kyoto home cooking that diners call nourishing. Expect a wait at noon and in the evening. A hot May 2026 day with only a fan was uncomfortable. Cash only. Closed Wednesday.

roles: Owner, cooking and serving alone (August 2026: "run by a quiet gentleman, operating solo")
chef_bio.background: Reviewers in 2026 describe a café on the third floor of a building near Sanjo-Takakura, furnished with antiques and vintage pieces, where one person runs everything and serves a single daily set of one soup and three dishes for ¥1,000.

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 diner who could not find the place at night was walked to the door by a staff member from a nearby okonomiyaki shop.
Turned away at 6:30 pm in June 2026, a diner came back 45 minutes later; on leaving, the diner received an apology for the earlier brusque welcome.
"It was a bit warm that day, and despite having air conditioning, only a fan was on, making it somewhat uncomfortable." — May 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 日常茶飯、カフェ・食堂、中京区枡屋町55 三条高倉白鳥ビル3F、烏丸御池駅から徒歩約10分、木〜火 12:00〜15:00・18:00〜21:00、水曜休み、予約不可、18席 (テーブル8、ソファ4〜5、カウンター6)、分煙 (昼は禁煙)、カード・電子マネー・QR不可。口コミ (2026年3月〜10月、英語): 一汁三菜の日替わり定食1,000円、五穀米や炊き込みご飯、味噌汁、漬物、昼は大盛り可、厚揚げのそぼろあんと大根、鶏つくねと厚揚げ、小鯵の南蛮漬け、蓮根とこんにゃくのきんぴら、オニオンサラダ、骨董に囲まれた店内、物静かな店主が一人で営業、昼も夜も待つことがある、暑い日に扇風機だけだったという声。

cultural_comfort.note: One set meal, so no menu to read; queue at busy times; cash only.

kyoto_hyakuten_manten.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat ramen noodles in a thick curry broth; curry rice made with a roux (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_hyakuten_manten.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the curry broth is built on dashi and the ramen comes with chashu (2026 reviews).
kyoto_hyakuten_manten.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon–Sat 11:00–22:30; Sun and holidays 11:00–19:00. Bookings taken; banquets for two or more from ¥4,000; private hire for 25–36. 36 seats: 12 at the counter, 24 at tables. Smoking allowed (Tabelog). No cards (Tabelog). No service charge listed on Tabelog. Weekday sets until 14:00 come with rice or a mini curry (Tabelog).
kyoto_hyakuten_manten.notes: [Curry ramen · Sanjo-Takakura, an old-style diner] Up the stairs beside the Museum of Kyoto, a nostalgic diner known for curry ramen: a thick, dashi-rich curry broth clinging to thin noodles, with fukujinzuke to stir in and rice for the last of the soup. Daily sets pair shoyu or miso ramen with a mini curry. Regulars love it; one found the noodles unremarkable. Open late on weekdays. Smoking allowed; no cards.

roles: Owner who makes the curry daily (Tabelog); not named
chef_bio.background: Tabelog says the owner makes the curry every day, simmering it for two days with 38 spices, and describes a bright, nostalgic diner for everyone from solo diners to families, with banquets for regulars. A September 2026 reviewer calls it a long-established ramen shop; an October 2026 diner was greeted by two friendly women and noticed a noodle-making machine by the second-floor entrance.

anecdotes.text: "I had known for years that this place served curry ramen, but I was always hesitant to step inside due to the unassuming entrance." — October 2026.
"The noodles were unremarkable, but the curry broth was classic and well-prepared." — September 2026.
A curry-ramen regular tried the daily miso ramen and mini curry set in November 2026 and found a new favourite.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ひゃくてんまんてん、ラーメン・カレー・居酒屋、中京区三条高倉西入ル京都文化博物館南側 くらしハウス2F、烏丸御池駅から徒歩3分、月〜土 11:00〜22:30、日・祝 11:00〜19:00、予約可、宴会は2名から4,000円〜、貸切25〜36名、36席 (カウンター12、テーブル24)、喫煙可、カード不可、店主が毎日作る38種のスパイスで2日煮込んだカレーライス680円、一番人気のカレーラーメン780円、平日14時までのセットはライスかミニカレー付き。口コミ (2025年11月〜2026年11月、英語): カレーラーメン1,100円 (2026年10月)、ライスセット200円とキムチ、細麺、チャーシュー、ねぎ、もやし、福神漬け、日替わりの醤油や味噌ラーメンとミニカレーのセット、カレーうどん、老舗、昭和の食堂のような雰囲気、二人の女性スタッフ、2階入口に製麺機、麺は普通という声。

cultural_comfort.note: Order at the counter or table; cash only; smoking allowed.

kyoto_vital_sign.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; vegetable plates sit beside pasta, couscous salad and pâté (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_vital_sign.vegan_detail: Ask. Vegetables lead — Kamo eggplant steak, hummus, grilled zucchini, herb salads — but many plates add fish, oysters, prosciutto, duck or pork (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_vital_sign.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon–Sat 18:00–23:30; closed Sunday; hours may change. Bookings taken; Instagram bookings at least two days ahead; urgent matters by phone (Tabelog). A 3% fee is added when paying by card (Tabelog; Japanese original 「クレジット使用時、手数料3%上乗せ」); no e-money or QR. 23 seats including a counter; non-smoking inside, ashtray under the eaves outside (Tabelog). Opened 1 April 2015 (Tabelog).
kyoto_vital_sign.notes: [Vegetables & natural wine · Shijo-Kawaramachi back alley] A dim, minimal room in a quiet alley off Kawaramachi where one chef cooks generous, inventive plates from organic Shizuhara and Tango vegetables — Kamo eggplant steak, oysters with turnip-green sauce on yuzu spaghetti, sansho pâté — to go with natural wine. With one cook, plates come slowly but well timed. 3% extra on cards. Closed Sunday.

roles: Chef who cooks alone (February 2026: "the chef prepares everything by himself"); not named
chef_bio.background: Opened 1 April 2015 (Tabelog). A February 2026 regular on a fourth visit describes organic vegetables from Kyoto’s Shizuhara and Tango, natural wines and non-alcoholic cocktails, all cooked by one chef; an April 2026 diner describes a concrete-toned, dimly lit, minimalist room.

anecdotes.text: "The serving speed was slow, but they timed it perfectly with the meal." — May 2026.
A February 2026 regular still remembers the oysters with turnip and turnip-green sauce on yuzu spaghetti.
"The assorted appetizers were packed with vegetables, so if you're craving fish, you might want to choose the carpaccio instead." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: バイタルサイン、野菜料理・創作料理・ワインバー、下京区船頭町235、京都河原町駅から199m、月〜土 18:00〜23:30、日曜休み、予約可 (Instagram からは2日前まで)、急ぎは電話、カード利用は手数料3%上乗せ、電子マネー・QR不可、23席、店内禁煙 (店外の軒下に灰皿)、2015年4月1日オープン。口コミ (2025年10月〜2026年10月、英語): Shizuhara と Tango の有機野菜、ナチュールワイン、ノンアルコールカクテル、料理人が一人で作る、賀茂茄子のステーキ、フムス、ズッキーニのグリル、オクラとモリンガとクスクスのハーブサラダ、山椒のパテ、鰹のカルパッチョ、牡蠣と蕪と蕪の葉のソースの柚子のスパゲッティ、栗のクリームパスタ、鴨の赤ワインソース、豚のロースト、赤海老のアメリケーヌ、白味噌と生ハムとシャインマスカット、ジャスミン茶のティラミス、カモミールのパンナコッタ、アフォガート、提供はゆっくり、静かな路地の薄暗くミニマルな店内。

cultural_comfort.note: À la carte at the counter or tables; book ahead, by Instagram two days in advance.
